roadmap.title: Prologue and the road to the Strip
roadmap.description: Start a Hardcore playthrough, finish the opening story quests through Ring-a-Ding-Ding, and reach the Strip.

roadmap.title: Mojave side quests, companions, and exploration
roadmap.description: Complete the major side quests and recruit companions while picking up exploration, crafting, repair, lock, terminal, barter, Speech, and snow-globe counters.

roadmap.title: Casinos, Caravan, and Strip counters
roadmap.description: Play enough Blackjack, Slots, Roulette, and Caravan to clear the gambling counters and earn a ban from all three Strip casinos.

roadmap.title: Dead Money
roadmap.description: Complete the Sierra Madre casino story, choose an ending for Father Elijah, and collect the chips and upgrades.

roadmap.title: Honest Hearts
roadmap.description: Complete the Zion Valley story and choose how the conflict with the White Legs ends.

roadmap.title: Old World Blues
roadmap.description: Complete Big MT, recover the Sink modules, and finish the X-8 and X-13 experiments.

roadmap.title: Lonesome Road
roadmap.description: Walk the Divide, find ED-E's upgrades, detonate the warheads, and finish Ulysses' story.

roadmap.title: Faction endings and the finale
roadmap.description: Keep a permanent save before the faction point of no return, then see the Mr. House, NCR, Legion, and Yes Man endings.

roadmap.title: Cleanup: level, damage, and GRA challenges
roadmap.description: Finish the level, location, mod, healing, and damage counters, then complete the Gun Runners' Arsenal challenges.

achievements.summary: Reach character level 10.

steps.text: Reach level 10 by finishing quests, clearing enemies, and looting locations as you progress through the main story.

achievements.summary: Reach character level 20.

steps.text: Keep earning experience from quests, combat, and DLC content until the character screen shows level 20.

achievements.summary: Reach character level 30.

guide.context: The level cap is 50, so reaching 30 happens naturally while completing the base game and the four story DLCs.

steps.text: Continue leveling through quests, combat, and DLC content until the character screen shows level 30.

achievements.summary: Recruit any one companion to follow the Courier.

guide.context: The Courier can travel with one humanoid companion and one robot companion at the same time.

steps.text: Recruit any one companion, such as @npc{ED-E} at the Nash residence in @loc{Primm} or @npc{Craig Boone} in @loc{Novac}.

achievements.summary: Recruit all eight base-game companions at least once.

guide.context: Only the eight base-game companions count; DLC companions do not. Each companion must join the Courier at least once, but the humanoid and robot travel slots allow only one of each at a time, so dismiss and swap as needed.

steps.text: Repair @npc{ED-E} at the Nash residence in @loc{Primm}: use Repair 65, or Science 55 with Repair 35, and bring 3 scrap metal, 2 sensor modules, and 1 scrap electronics.
steps.note: Companions can die permanently in Hardcore mode, so recruit each one before it is lost.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Arcade Gannon} at the @loc{Old Mormon Fort} by passing a Speech 75 check, finishing High Times, having the Confirmed Bachelor perk, or earning high Followers of the Apocalypse fame.
Finish @npc{Craig Boone}'s quest One for My Baby in @loc{Novac}; he is inside the dinosaur at night.
Finish @npc{Lily Bowen}'s quest Guess Who I Saw Today in @loc{Jacobstown}.
Free @npc{Raul Alfonso Tejada} from the prison building on @loc{Black Mountain}.
Finish @npc{Rose of Sharon Cassidy}'s quest Heartache by the Number at the @loc{Mojave Outpost}.
Talk to @npc{Veronica Santangelo} at the @loc{188 trading post} and agree to travel together.
Finish @npc{Rex}'s quest Nothin' But a Hound Dog at the @loc{King's School of Impersonation}.

achievements.summary: Craft 20 items at any crafting station.

guide.context: Breaking down spare ammunition at a reloading bench also counts toward the total.

steps.text: Use a @mechanic{workbench}, campfire, or @mechanic{reloading bench} to craft 20 items; a workbench is available in @loc{Goodsprings}.

achievements.summary: Install 20 weapon mods from the Pip-Boy.

guide.context: Mods are fitted from the Pip-Boy inventory, not at a merchant.

steps.text: Buy weapon mods from merchants; the @loc{Gun Runners} near the east Freeside gate stock the widest selection.
Open the Pip-Boy inventory, select a compatible weapon, and fit mods until 20 are installed.
steps.note: Save before buying, install the mods, then reload to keep the caps; the achievement stays unlocked.

achievements.summary: Discover 50 named map locations.

steps.text: Travel to new map markers until 50 locations are discovered; undiscovered nearby markers appear as hollow triangles on the compass.

achievements.summary: Discover 125 named map locations.

guide.context: The base game contains 187 locations and DLC locations also count toward the total.

steps.text: Keep discovering new map locations until 125 are found.
steps.note: The @mechanic{Explorer} perk reveals every map marker, making the remaining locations easy to visit.

achievements.summary: Collect all seven base-game snow globes.

guide.context: Only the seven base-game snow globes count; the four DLC snow globes do not.

collectibles.name: Goodsprings snow globe
collectibles.location: @loc{Goodsprings Cemetery}, on a grave without a cross
collectibles.method: Pick up the snow globe.

collectibles.name: Hoover Dam snow globe
collectibles.location: Welcome desk of the @loc{Hoover Dam} Visitor Center, across from the entrance
collectibles.method: Pick up the snow globe.

collectibles.name: Old Mormon Fort snow globe
collectibles.location: @loc{Old Mormon Fort} tower, on top of the wooden bookcase
collectibles.method: Pick up the snow globe.
collectibles.note: The tower holds Julie Farkas' office.

collectibles.name: Jacobstown snow globe
collectibles.location: @loc{Jacobstown} lodge, on the reception desk near the entrance
collectibles.method: Pick up the snow globe.

collectibles.name: Nellis snow globe
collectibles.location: @loc{Nellis Air Force Base} museum, on the table right of the entrance
collectibles.method: Pick up the snow globe.

collectibles.name: Lucky 38 snow globe
collectibles.location: @loc{The Strip}: Lucky 38 cocktail lounge, behind a cash register
collectibles.method: Pick up the snow globe.

collectibles.name: Vault 21 snow globe
collectibles.location: @loc{The Strip}: @loc{Vault 21}, in Sarah's bedroom on the table
collectibles.method: Lockpick the average-lock door, then pick up the snow globe.

achievements.summary: Sell 10,000 caps' worth of goods to merchants.

guide.context: Purchases from merchants also advance the counter, so buying and selling both help.

steps.text: Trade with merchants until the total value of goods bought and sold reaches 10,000 caps.

achievements.summary: Deal 10,000 damage with Energy Weapons.

guide.context: Sneak-attack criticals count, and the YCS/186 is a strong choice.

steps.text: Deal 10,000 total damage with @mechanic{Energy Weapons}.
steps.note: Save, attack the crowds on the Strip, then reload once the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Deal 10,000 damage with Explosives.

guide.context: The automatic grenade launcher makes short work of groups.

steps.text: Deal 10,000 total damage with @mechanic{Explosives}.
steps.note: Save, attack the crowds on the Strip, then reload once the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Deal 10,000 damage with Guns.

steps.text: Deal 10,000 total damage with @mechanic{Guns}.
steps.note: Save, attack the crowds on the Strip, then reload once the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Pick 25 locks.

steps.text: Pick locks throughout the Mojave until 25 are opened, and carry plenty of bobby pins.
steps.note: Lockpick requirements rise from 0 for Very Easy to 100 for Very Hard locks.

achievements.description: Heal 10,000 points of damage with Stimpaks.
achievements.summary: Restore 10,000 points of health using Stimpaks.

guide.context: The Medicine skill changes how many Stimpaks are needed to reach the total.

steps.text: Buy Stimpaks in bulk, damage yourself, and use Stimpaks until 10,000 points are healed.

achievements.summary: Deal 10,000 damage with Melee Weapons.

guide.context: The Thermic Lance and the katana are strong choices.

steps.text: Deal 10,000 total damage with @mechanic{Melee Weapons}.

achievements.summary: Repair 30 items.

guide.context: Repairs need a similar donor item unless the level-90 Repair perk Jury Rigging is taken.

steps.text: Loot weapons and armor from defeated enemies, then repair 30 items from the Pip-Boy.

achievements.summary: Hack 25 terminals.

steps.text: Hack terminals until 25 are opened, and raise Science to reach harder terminals.
steps.note: Save before a hack; a failed hack locks the terminal.

achievements.summary: Pick 50 pockets.

guide.context: Sarah Weintrob at the @loc{Vault 21} shop on the Strip carries bubblegum that does not disappear when stolen, so it can be stolen repeatedly.

steps.text: At the Vault 21 shop, hide behind the counter with a @item{Stealth Boy} until the status reads unseen, then pickpocket the bubblegum.
Exit the pickpocket screen and repeat until 50 pockets have been picked.
steps.note: Sarah may notice you; reload and continue. The whole method takes about ten minutes.

achievements.summary: Pass 50 Speech skill checks in dialogue.

guide.context: Speech checks in the base game and in every DLC count toward the total.

steps.text: Pass @mechanic{Speech} skill checks in dialogue until 50 have succeeded.
steps.note: Raising Speech early makes this counter easy.

achievements.description: Heal 10,000 points of damage with food.
achievements.summary: Restore 10,000 points of health using food.

guide.context: In Hardcore mode food can be eaten continuously while health is below maximum, and every bite counts. Arcade Gannon's companion perk adds 20% to all healing.

steps.text: Buy food and water in bulk from @npc{William Farber} at @loc{Camp McCarran}, or hunt bighorners and geckos to cook steaks.
Reduce health to nearly empty, then eat the stored food until 10,000 points are healed.
steps.note: If Hardcore mode is available to enable, turn it on before eating so every bite registers.

steps.text: Pass three to six days so William Farber restocks, then repeat as needed.

achievements.summary: Deal 10,000 damage with Unarmed weapons.

guide.context: Power fists, especially the Ballistic Fist, deal the damage fastest.

steps.text: Deal 10,000 total damage with @mechanic{Unarmed weapons}, such as against radscorpions at the Thorn or ghouls at the old nuclear test site south of Nipton.

achievements.summary: Win 3 games of Caravan.

steps.text: Win three games of @mechanic{Caravan} against any opponent.

achievements.summary: Play 10 spins on a Slot machine.

steps.text: Play 10 spins on a Slot machine in any casino.

achievements.summary: Play 10 spins at a Roulette table.

steps.text: Play 10 spins at a Roulette table in any casino.

achievements.summary: Play 10 hands of Blackjack.

guide.context: Winning the hands is not required.

steps.text: Play 10 hands of @mechanic{Blackjack} in any casino.

achievements.summary: Win 30 games of Caravan.

guide.context: A caravan is a pile totalling 21 to 26. The King doubles the card it is placed on and can also push an opponent's caravan above 26; the Jack discards the card beneath it.

steps.text: Get a free Caravan deck from @npc{Ringo} in @loc{Goodsprings}.
Remove all Queens, all Jokers, and every card below 5 from the deck.
Win 30 games, building three descending piles that each total 21 to 26.
steps.note: Other opponents include Cliff Briscoe and Noonan in Novac, the NCR embassy on the Strip, Camp McCarran, Camp Forlorn Hope, the Mojave Outpost, Primm, North Vegas Square, and the Gun Runners.

achievements.displayName: The Courier Who Broke the Bank
achievements.description: Get banned from all the Strip's casinos.
achievements.summary: Get banned from all three Strip casinos.

guide.context: Each Strip casino bans the player after a win threshold: Gomorrah at 9,000 caps, The Tops at 10,000 caps, and the Ultra-Luxe at 15,000 caps. Lower win totals pay smaller rewards first.

steps.text: Raise @mechanic{Luck} to 9 or higher with the Intense Training perk, a Luck implant, a formal outfit, and Lucky Shades if the Legion likes you.
Play @mechanic{Blackjack} at the maximum bet in each Strip casino until that casino bans you.

achievements.description: Play the game from start to finish in Hardcore Mode.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story in Hardcore mode with the setting enabled from the start.

guide.context: Hardcore is a survival toggle independent of the difficulty setting. Stimpaks and RadAway heal over time, Doctor's Bags only partially heal limbs, ammunition has weight, companions can die, and the Courier must eat, drink, and sleep.

steps.text: Enable @mechanic{Hardcore mode} when the game asks as you leave Doc Mitchell's house in @loc{Goodsprings}.
Keep the Courier fed, hydrated, and rested, and carry water, food, and ammunition.
Finish the main story with Hardcore still enabled; it cannot be switched off before the first completion.
steps.note: Water fountains on the Strip and fast-travelling to a bed make survival needs easy to manage.

achievements.displayName: Ain't That a Kick in the Head
achievements.description: Complete Ain't That a Kick in the Head.
achievements.summary: Complete the opening quest Ain't That a Kick in the Head.

steps.text: Follow the opening quest Ain't That a Kick in the Head to completion.

achievements.summary: Complete the story quest They Went That-a-Way.

steps.text: Follow the main story through They Went That-a-Way to completion.

achievements.summary: Complete the story quest Ring-a-Ding-Ding.

steps.text: Follow the main story through Ring-a-Ding-Ding to completion, then make a permanent save before choosing a faction.

achievements.summary: Complete the Mr. House quest The House Always Wins.

guide.context: This route is locked out once another faction's endgame is committed.

steps.text: Follow Mr. House's instructions from the Lucky 38 and complete The House Always Wins.

achievements.summary: Complete the NCR quest For the Republic.

guide.context: This route is locked out once another faction's endgame is committed.

steps.text: Follow the NCR quest line and complete For the Republic.

achievements.summary: Complete the Caesar's Legion quest Render Unto Caesar.

guide.context: This route is locked out once another faction's endgame is committed, and Legion reputation is hard to restore once lost.

steps.text: Follow Caesar's Legion's quest line and complete Render Unto Caesar.

achievements.summary: Complete the Yes Man quest Wild Card.

guide.context: The Yes Man route stays available if other routes are abandoned.

steps.text: Follow Yes Man's instructions and complete Wild Card.

achievements.summary: Complete the Mr. House ending quest All or Nothing.

steps.text: See the Mr. House ending by completing All or Nothing.

achievements.summary: Complete the Caesar's Legion ending quest Veni, Vidi, Vici.

steps.text: See the Caesar's Legion ending by completing Veni, Vidi, Vici.

achievements.summary: Complete the NCR ending quest Eureka!

steps.text: See the NCR ending by completing Eureka!

achievements.summary: Complete the Yes Man ending quest No Gods, No Masters.

steps.text: See the Yes Man ending by completing No Gods, No Masters.

achievements.summary: Complete the Novac side quest Come Fly With Me.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Manny Vargas} in @loc{Novac} to start Come Fly With Me, then finish the Repconn test site objectives.

achievements.summary: Complete the Strip side quest Talent Pool.

steps.text: Offer help to @npc{Tommy Torini} at the Aces theater in @loc{The Tops} casino to start Talent Pool.

Recruit the four performers: @npc{Billy Knight} outside The Tops, @npc{Hadrian} at the Atomic Wrangler, @npc{The Lonesome Drifter}, who waits near the Sunset Sarsaparilla billboard by @loc{El Dorado Dry Lake}, and @npc{Bruce Isaac}, found upstairs at @loc{Novac}'s Dino Dee-lite Motel.
Return to Tommy Torini to finish the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete the quest Return to Sender.

steps.text: Start Return to Sender by speaking with @npc{Tech Sergeant Reyes} in the @loc{Camp Forlorn Hope} command center.
Upgrade the six ranger stations by talking to the troops at each one.
Confront @npc{Chief Hanlon} at @loc{Camp Golf} to finish the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete the Caesar's Legion quest Arizona Killer.

guide.context: The quest can fail, and it is unavailable if you side against Caesar's Legion.

steps.text: Follow Caesar's Legion's plan to assassinate President Kimball and complete Arizona Killer.

achievements.displayName: You'll Know It When It Happens
achievements.description: Complete You'll Know It When It Happens.
achievements.summary: Complete the quest You'll Know It When It Happens.

guide.context: Available on the NCR, Mr. House, and Yes Man routes, and requires good NCR relations; it cannot be done for Caesar's Legion. The quest can fail.

steps.text: Protect President Kimball during his visit and complete You'll Know It When It Happens.

achievements.summary: Complete the Freeside quest G.I. Blues.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{The King} at the @loc{King's School of Impersonation} in @loc{Freeside} to start G.I. Blues.
Carry out the King's requests and defuse the situation with the NCR to finish the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete the HELIOS One quest That Lucky Old Sun.

guide.context: The power destination changes the reward: the full region grants a Big Book of Science and Followers fame, McCarran and the Strip grant NCR fame, and Archimedes II grants an orbital weapon at the cost of NCR fame.

steps.text: Start That Lucky Old Sun from @npc{Lt. Haggerty} at the main entrance of @loc{HELIOS One} or from @npc{Fantastic} inside.
Connect to the mainframe from the reflector control terminals on the east and west sides, then restore power.
Route the power to a destination, then return to complete the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete the Boomers quest Volare!.

guide.context: The quest is part of the Mr. House, NCR, Legion, and Yes Man quest lines. Boomer fame comes fastest from asking every question at the Boomers' museum.

steps.text: Earn Boomer fame, then complete Volare! with the Boomers at @loc{Nellis Air Force Base}.

achievements.description: Complete The Legend of the Star.
achievements.summary: Complete the Sunset Sarsaparilla quest The Legend of the Star.

guide.context: Fifty Sunset Sarsaparilla star bottle caps are needed. They are scattered across the Mojave, and drinking Sunset Sarsaparilla can also produce one.

steps.text: Talk to the robot @npc{Festus} at the @loc{Sunset Sarsaparilla Headquarters} to start The Legend of the Star.
Collect 50 Sunset Sarsaparilla star bottle caps.
Return to Festus, then claim the prize inside the headquarters to finish the quest.

achievements.description: Recruit Dean Domino, Christine and Dog.
achievements.summary: In Dead Money, recruit Dean Domino, Christine, and Dog.

steps.text: Follow the Dead Money story and recruit @npc{Dean Domino}, @npc{Christine}, and @npc{Dog} to the crew.

achievements.description: Confront Father Elijah in the Sierra Madre's Vault.
achievements.summary: Confront and kill Father Elijah in the Sierra Madre vault.

guide.context: This outcome is mutually exclusive with trapping Father Elijah.

steps.text: Enter the Sierra Madre vault and save.
Use the vault terminal to convince @npc{Father Elijah} to come down.
Kill Father Elijah when he appears.

achievements.description: Complete the Sierra Madre Gala Event.
achievements.summary: Finish the Sierra Madre gala event in Dead Money.

steps.text: Follow the Dead Money story until the Sierra Madre gala event is completed.

achievements.description: Trap Father Elijah in the Sierra Madre's Vault.
achievements.summary: Trap Father Elijah inside the Sierra Madre vault.

guide.context: A character skill of 75 in one of Explosives, Science, Repair, Lockpick, Barter, Speech, or Sneak is needed to pass the vault dialogue check. This outcome is mutually exclusive with killing Father Elijah.

steps.text: Save before speaking with @npc{Father Elijah} in the Sierra Madre vault.
Pass the 75-skill dialogue check to convince him to come down.
Do not wait for him: leave the way you entered, make sure the vault door closes, and take the elevator on the left.

achievements.summary: Collect 500 Sierra Madre chips.

guide.context: Chips lie in fountains, containers, and houses around the villa, and casino tables pay out more once the power is on. The Sierra Madre snow globe is worth 2,000 chips.

steps.text: Collect Sierra Madre chips from the villa and the casino until 500 are held.
If chips are short, drop 100 chips and pick them up again five times to advance the counter.
steps.note: The Sierra Madre snow globe alone grants a large batch of chips.

achievements.displayName: May my Hand Forget its Skill
achievements.summary: Evacuate Zion by leading the Sorrows out with Daniel.

guide.context: This ending is mutually exclusive with crushing the White Legs. Save when Gathering Storms begins.

steps.text: During Gathering Storms, choose to evacuate Zion with @npc{Daniel} and complete the evacuation.

achievements.description: Scout the Zion Valley for signs of the White Legs.
achievements.summary: Scout the Zion Valley for evidence of the White Legs.

steps.text: Follow the Honest Hearts story and complete the scouting objectives for signs of the White Legs.

achievements.summary: Crush the White Legs with Joshua Graham.

guide.context: This ending is mutually exclusive with evacuating Zion.

steps.text: During Gathering Storms, agree to fight the White Legs alongside @npc{Joshua Graham} and complete the battle.

achievements.summary: Arrive at Zion in the Honest Hearts DLC.

steps.text: Travel through the northern passage and arrive at @loc{Zion} to begin Honest Hearts.

achievements.summary: Resupply Daniel and the Sorrows in Zion.

steps.text: Follow the Honest Hearts story and complete the resupply quest for @npc{Daniel} and the Sorrows.

achievements.description: Search your feelings... for your heart.
achievements.summary: Recover the Stealth Suit Mk II from the X-13 research facility.

steps.text: Doctor Klein gives the quest X-13: Attack of the Infiltrator!; travel to the X-13 research facility.
Complete the infiltration sequence to obtain the @item{Stealth Suit Mk II}.

achievements.description: Reactivate all of the Sink's robotic assistants.
achievements.summary: Reactivate all nine of the Sink's robotic assistants.

guide.context: Complete the quest All My Friends Have Off Switches. Install the Sink Central Intelligence Unit first, then recover the nine personality modules and install them at the Sink.

collectibles.name: Auto-Doc module
collectibles.location: Y-17 medical facility, second floor, on the table right of the stairs
collectibles.method: Recover the module and install it at the Sink.

collectibles.name: Sink module
collectibles.location: Magnetohydraulics complex, on the table beside the broken terminal
collectibles.method: Recover the module and install it at the Sink.

collectibles.name: Biological Research Station module
collectibles.location: X-22 botanical garden, on the ground under the stairs next to the hot plate
collectibles.method: Recover the module and install it at the Sink.

collectibles.name: Light Switch 01 module
collectibles.location: X-2 transmitter antenna array, on the table left of the entrance near the coffee machine
collectibles.method: Recover the module and install it at the Sink.

collectibles.name: Light Switch 02 module
collectibles.location: Big MT north tunnel, in the room right of the entrance on the tool shelf
collectibles.method: Recover the module and install it at the Sink.

collectibles.name: Book Chute module
collectibles.location: Higgs Village house 101, second floor
collectibles.method: Recover the module and install it at the Sink.

collectibles.name: Jukebox module
collectibles.location: Higgs Village house 108, second floor
collectibles.method: Recover the module and install it at the Sink.

collectibles.name: Toaster module
collectibles.location: The Cuckoo's Nest, on the makeshift altar right of the entrance
collectibles.method: Recover the module and install it at the Sink.

collectibles.name: Muggy module
collectibles.location: Securitron de-construction plant, on the truck in front of the factory entrance
collectibles.method: Recover the module and install it at the Sink.

achievements.description: Make up your mind... about your brain.
achievements.summary: Convince the Courier's own brain to return during Old World Blues.

guide.context: A Speech skill of 75 is needed to convince the brain to return and to unlock this achievement.

steps.text: After meeting @npc{Doctor Mobius}, find the Courier's brain.
Pass the Speech 75 check to convince the brain to return.

achievements.summary: Complete the Old World Blues DLC.

steps.text: Follow the Old World Blues story through the Think Tank to its conclusion.

achievements.summary: Complete the X-8 high school experiment in Big MT.

steps.text: Accept the quest X-8: High School Horror! from @npc{Doctor Klein}.
Complete every objective at the X-8 research center.

achievements.description: Found all of ED-E's upgrades in the Divide.
achievements.summary: Find all five ED-E upgrade modules in the Divide.

guide.context: The five modules are found inside damaged eyebots. Two need extra steps: the Ashton silo module is behind a door opened from an adjacent hard terminal, and the Cave of the Abaddon module is behind a warhead that must be detonated.

collectibles.name: Hopeville silo module
collectibles.location: Hopeville silo bunker, behind the door left of the entrance in the corridor
collectibles.method: Collect the module from the damaged eyebot.

collectibles.name: Hopeville Missile Base module
collectibles.location: In the @loc{Hopeville Missile Base} HQ office area left of the entrance, beneath a desk
collectibles.method: Collect the module from the damaged eyebot.

collectibles.name: Ashton silo module
collectibles.location: Ashton silo control station, level 1 of the launch shaft behind the large door
collectibles.method: Open the door from the adjacent hard terminal with Science 75, then collect the module.

collectibles.name: Third Street module
collectibles.location: Third Street Municipal Building, in the pipe between the second and third floors
collectibles.method: Collect the module from the damaged eyebot in the municipal sewers.

collectibles.name: Cave of the Abaddon module
collectibles.location: Just right of the Cave of the Abaddon entrance, behind a building fragment and a warhead
collectibles.method: Detonate the warhead to reveal the damaged eyebot, then collect the module.

achievements.description: Decided the fate of all the Divide dwellers.
achievements.summary: Decide the fate of the Divide dwellers.

steps.text: Follow the Lonesome Road story to its final decision and choose an outcome for the Divide.

achievements.summary: Complete the Lonesome Road DLC.

steps.text: Follow Lonesome Road through the Divide and confront Ulysses to finish the DLC.

achievements.description: Fully upgraded The Divide's signature weapon.
achievements.summary: Buy all three Red Glare weapon upgrades in the Divide.

guide.context: The upgrades cost at least 30,000 caps in total. They only need to be bought, not installed. The Divide can be revisited after the DLC ends to buy them later.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Red Glare} when tasked with retrieving the laser detonator.
Buy all three @item{Red Glare} upgrades from the Divide's military commissaries.
steps.note: Sell equipment at a save to raise the caps, then reload afterward.

achievements.description: Detonated all of the warheads in the Divide.
achievements.summary: Detonate all 30 warheads in the Divide.

guide.context: The laser detonator is required. Twenty-four warheads are outdoors and marked on the map; the other six are inside the temple.

steps.text: Carry the @item{laser detonator} and detonate every unexploded warhead in the Divide until 30 have exploded.

achievements.description: Caused 10,000 damage with unique Mojave Wasteland weapons.
achievements.summary: Deal 10,000 damage with unique named Mojave Wasteland weapons.

guide.context: Any weapon with its own unique name qualifies, such as Benny's pistol Maria. Damage also counts toward that weapon's base category.

steps.text: Deal 10,000 total damage using unique named Mojave Wasteland weapons.

achievements.description: Caused 10,000 damage with Gun Runners' Arsenal (GRA) Weapons.
achievements.summary: Deal 10,000 damage using weapons from the Gun Runners' Arsenal DLC.

guide.context: GRA weapons carry the GRA tag in their name.

steps.text: Deal 10,000 total damage with @mechanic{GRA weapons}.
steps.note: Buying the Esther launcher and mini nukes from the Gun Runners, then attacking a crowd in New Vegas, is a fast route.

achievements.description: Completed any three Gun Runners' Arsenal (GRA) one star (*) Challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete any three one-star Gun Runners' Arsenal challenges.

guide.context: An enemy may be weakened with any weapon and finished with the required one. Progress is tracked in the Pip-Boy challenges list.

steps.text: Cripple the right arm of five enemies with shotguns for the Ne Ne Ne Ne challenge.
Kill 20 abominations such as deathclaws and night stalkers with katanas, dynamite, machetes, or thrown melee weapons for the You Don't Belong In This World challenge.
Kill 15 robots with the 5.56mm pistol (GRA) for the Benefit Or a Hazard challenge.

achievements.description: Completed any three Gun Runners' Arsenal (GRA) two star (**) Challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete any three two-star Gun Runners' Arsenal challenges.

guide.context: An enemy may be weakened with any weapon and finished with the required one. Progress is tracked in the Pip-Boy challenges list.

steps.text: Use baseball bats, lead pipes, machetes, tire irons, sawed-off shotguns, or .44 Magnum revolvers to kill 20 Fiends, Vipers, or Jackals for the White Line Nightmare challenge.
Use a minigun, light machine gun, or submachine gun to kill 10 Chairmen, White Gloves, and Omertas for the Nyah! See? challenge.
Use 5.56mm pistols, the Bozar, rippers, power fists, plasma grenades, or Plasma Defenders to kill 15 super mutants for the Vault 13's Revenge challenge.

achievements.description: Completed any three Gun Runners' Arsenal (GRA) three star (***) Challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete any three three-star Gun Runners' Arsenal challenges.

guide.context: An enemy may be weakened with any weapon and finished with the required one. These are the hardest challenges in Gun Runners' Arsenal.

steps.text: Use tin grenades, long-fuse dynamite, or time bombs to kill 10 Mojave Cazadores for the Crackerjack Timing challenge.
Use brass knuckles, spiked knuckles, tire irons, or lead pipes to kill 10 Mojave Mr. Gutsys or Sentry Bots for the Man-Machine Interface challenge.
Use Ranger Sequoias, brush guns, cowboy repeaters, hunting revolvers, hunting rifles, or service rifles to kill 10 named Legion members for the Against All Tyrants challenge.
